attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength, Melee, or Survival skill + 1d6. If not proficient with weapons and you also do not have the Survival skill, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4. 

Recharge this card to add 1d6 to your Survival check.
